title: Revit Annotation Standards
purpose: Apply controlled annotation styles and behaviors for text, dimensions, tags, symbols, and keynotes without promoting unresolved source-era sizes, family names, or formatting examples into canonical values.
preconditions: Approved annotation types and supporting parameters are available from the governed template/library context.
Project units and discipline-specific documentation requirements are known.

steps.name: Use approved annotation types
actions: Use approved text, dimension, tag, symbol, and keynote types from governed project/template content.
Do not create duplicate local annotation types solely to change isolated formatting.
validation: Placed annotations use approved governed types.
Uncontrolled duplicate types are absent or explicitly recorded for remediation.

steps.name: Apply dimension and notation rules consistently
actions: Use the project-governed units and precision for the annotation context.
Avoid manual formatting overrides where governed annotation types provide the required behavior.
Use practical install/documentation precision appropriate to the governed discipline/project requirements.
validation: Dimension styles, units, precision, leaders, and symbols are internally consistent with project standards.
No ungoverned source-example precision or tolerance value is treated as mandatory.

steps.name: Use parameter-driven tags and governed annotation codes
actions: Use approved tag families tied to governed parameters.
Use keynotes/annotation codes through the governed data source where applicable.
Do not replace governed tags or keynote behavior with exploded CAD, manual detail lines, or free text where a governed data-driven annotation is required.
validation: Tags resolve to governed parameters and display intended information.
Keynote/code use is traceable to the applicable governed source where available.

outputs: Consistent Revit annotation using governed text/dimension/tag/symbol/keynote structures
future_dependencies: Exact family names and discipline-specific appearance rules
governance_notes: Exact text sizes, fonts, dimension precision values, family names, and keynote graphics marked TODO/example in source remain unresolved.
Annotation semantics that depend on parameters remain subordinate to S8 parameter authority.

provenance.migration_note: Migrated durable annotation-control rules only; unresolved style values and family names remain noncanonical.
